Dharmesh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 19
May, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6571 of 2023
Applicant :- Dharmesh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Arun Singh Somvanshi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Arun Singh Somvanshi, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Amit Kumar Dwivedi,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
489 of 2022, under Sections 323, 376, 457, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Mitauli, District Lakhimpur Kheri.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 25.12.2022 on the basis of an application under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. stating that on 07.12.2022, when the informant was alone in her house, the applicant armed with a pistol entered her house at about 8.00 p.m. and under the treat to kill her with pistol he raped her.

After the incident when the applicant went out of her house the informant raised cry, whereupon the applicant returned and hit her with butt of the pistol causing injury over her right eyebrow and the informant fell unconscious.
Dharmesh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

1 4.
In the statements of the informant recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. she did not make a mention of any pistol as also of the injury caused by butt of the pistol.

In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. the informant stated that after causing the incident applicant went away and thereafter she raised cry, whereupon wife of her husband's elder brother came there.
5. In the medico legal examination report of the victim, no injury has been reported on any part of her body.

6. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
7. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the delay in lodging the F.I.R. and the discrepancies in the statements of the informant in the F.I.R., in her statement given before the Investigating Officer and her statement given before the Magistrate coupled with the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 25.02.2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
(Subhash Vidyarthi, J.) Order Date :- 19.5.2023

Ram.
